column1: # Mock model catalogs for tests/routecheck.sh's Tier 0.5 catalog-drift tests.
# DATA ONLY: a routing change edits this file, never routecheck.sh (the model
# scout auto-merges data files, not code). Tab-separated:
#       an id the mock `cursor-agent --list-models` / `codex debug models`
#       returns, and what catalog-drift must make of it against bin/routes.tsv:
#       routed = a `model` row (every routed cursor/codex id must be listed,
#       or it is reported vanished); unrouted = must show in --unrouted;
#       ignored = matched by an `ignore` row; hidden = codex visibility "hide".
#       a "newer" finding catalog-drift must print, e.g. grok-4.8-* while
#       routes.tsv stops at grok-4.7. Keep one hypothetical next version per
#       family AHEAD of the routed ones (bump it when the real one is routed).
#       a routed id deliberately left out of the catalog (must be reported).
# The findings must match EXACTLY: an unlisted newer/vanished/unrouted finding
# fails the test. gpt-5.7-sol: an old-version tier the version-max logic can't
# see — must be unrouted but NOT newer (routed gpt-6 outranks 5.7).
